description: List fired alerts. Returns the project's FIRED alerts as a **bare JSON array** (no pagination envelope), ordered by `createdAt desc`. Defaults to the currently-firing ones (`status=active`); pass a `status` to widen to resolved/dismissed history or `all`.

status.description: Filter by lifecycle state. Defaults to `active` (currently firing); `all` returns every status.

name: ops_fired_alerts_list
